one_line: A medium-weight Stefan Feld dice-and-tile game where you roll two dice a turn to draft hexagonal tiles and fill the regions of your personal Burgundian duchy board across five phases.
A two-player asymmetric Lord of the Rings war game where the Free Peoples and Shadow race between a hunt for the Ring-bearer and a continent-wide military campaign.
A heavy sci-fi engine-builder and territory game where one of 14 factions terraforms planets, climbs six research tracks and builds federations across a modular galaxy.

publisher: Feuerland Spiele / Z-Man Games / Capstone Games
one_line: A heavy strategy game where each of 14 factions terraforms its home terrain, builds and upgrades buildings, joins four cults and fights for room on a shared hex map.

A semi-cooperative fantasy dungeon crawler where one player is the evil wizard Zargon and up to four heroes (Barbarian, Dwarf, Elf, Wizard) fight through 14 quests with 65+ miniatures; this is the 2021 Hasbro edition with a free companion app.
